text:
vikram: Quick ping — can someone take a look at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123? It's a tokenizer compatibility + quant profiles change for nova-3b variant. Need one LGTM and CI green before merge window.

olivia: :eyes: I'll review after standup (about 2 hours). Any perf regressions expected?

vikram: Small perf diff expected for long-context (>2048) due to padding alignment change. Numbers: baseline -> 1.02x token latency. Should be fine. Also added fallback for unknown unicode seqs.

vikram: Code snippet of the main change:
```
# tokenizer config tweak
special_token_map = {
  "<pad>": 0,
  "<unk>": 1,
  "<s>": 2
}
# added normalize_unicode flag to handle malformed bytes
```

ci-bot: CI: Test run started for PR #4123 — 12 jobs queued. https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4123

james: Heads up — unit test `test_tokenizer_roundtrip` is flaky on macos due to nondet seed. If CI fails, try adding deterministic RNG seed in the harness.

olivia: Left a couple inline comments: 1) prefer explicit normalizer function, 2) add a small unit test for the 1-token overflow case (edge-case where input ends with half char). Otherwise looks good.

vikram: thanks, pushed fixes for the comments and added the unit test. Triggering re-run.

ci-bot: CI: build failed — 3 tests failed in job 'python-unit' (flaky failure). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4123/logs

james: appears to be the nondet test again. I can drop a patch to seed the harness if you want.

vikram: please do — that should be quick. I won't block the merge window.

james: pushed a tiny PR to the test harness, rebase done on #4123.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — ✅ build passed for PR #4123 (run id 9876).

tara: Thanks all. I'll give an approval once CI is green and Olivia gives the final sign-off. Merge window opens at 17:00 PT, we can merge then to minimize infra churn.

olivia: LGTM. Verified tokenizer behaviour on some corner-cases locally. :thumbsup:

tara: Approved on my side too. Please merge during the 17:00 PT window.

vikram: Merging now. Thanks everyone! :tada:

ci-bot: Merge: PR #4123 merged into main by vikram. Deploy pipeline triggered: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/deploy/459

vikram: Leaving a note in the release notes channel about the config flag and suggested migration steps.

olivia: Nice, will watch the canary metrics.

tara: great work team — short and clean review flow. :rocket:
